Page.Name: page.home
Page.Title: Raven Components
Page.Subtitle: Every widget Raven ships with, one page each, and a few built here on top of it. Pages tagged RAVEN use only what the library gives; pages tagged CUSTOM are made in this app, painted with Raven's drawing API or composed from its widgets. Every page is an XML file in src/pages: save one while the app runs and it reloads.

QuickLink.Title: Data table
QuickLink.Text: Custom: check rows, unfold them, drag column edges, colored tiles.

QuickLink.Title: macOS context menu
QuickLink.Text: Custom: a real NSMenu with SF Symbols, opened over Raven.

QuickLink.Title: Segmented control
QuickLink.Text: Custom: painted, with a thumb on a spring.

QuickLink.Title: Themes & looks
QuickLink.Text: macOS, Liquid Glass, Windows 11, GNOME and Raven, side by side.

QuickLink.Title: Node graph
QuickLink.Text: Nodes, typed pins, wires that hang and swing.

QuickLink.Title: Surfaces & effects
QuickLink.Text: Shader backgrounds, blur, glass and shadows.

Page.Label: | Asked for | Where | How | |---|---|---| | Native macOS context menu | Custom | NSMenu from the NSWindow Raven gives (`Rwindow_get_native_handle`) | | Raven context menu | Navigation | `Rwidget_set_context_menu`, `Rmenu_open` | | Data table (toggle rows, resizable columns, colored tiles) | Custom | `<DataTable>`: a CUSTOM widget painted with `Rdraw_*` | | Button group | Custom | `<ButtonGroup>`: a tag declared in XML | | Breadcrumbs | Navigation | `<Breadcrumb>` | | Collapse | Layout | `<Expander>`, and `toggle:NAME` on any widget | | Tree | Data | `<TreeView>` | | Segmented control | Custom | `<SegmentedControl>`: painted, registered with `Rxml_register_tag` | | File input | Custom | `<FileInput>`: declared tag + `Rfile_dialog_open` | | Alert | Overlays | `Rmessage_box` | | Modal | Overlays | `Rdialog_open` with any XML | | Popover | Custom | a Canvas layer over the window, placed under its anchor | | Toast | Overlays | `<Toast>` | | Tooltip | Overlays | `Tooltip=` on any widget | | Date picker | Date & time | `<DatePicker>` |
